name: intechral-client-portal-dev
description: Developer scripts for the Intechral Client Portal dev environment

scripts.setup:
npm run build && docker compose up -d && docker compose exec app cp .env.example .env && docker compose exec app chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache && docker compose exec app composer install && docker compose exec app php artisan key:generate && docker compose exec app php artisan migrate --seed && docker compose exec app npm install && docker compose exec app chmod -R 755 node_modules/.bin && docker compose exec app npm run build && echo "
  Setup complete. Open http://localhost:4242
"
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d && docker compose exec app bash -c 'test -f .env || cp .env.example .env' && docker compose exec app chmod -R 777 storage bootstrap/cache && docker compose exec app npm install && docker compose exec app chmod -R 755 node_modules/.bin && docker compose exec app npm run dev
